params.message:
Add the DealerEdge acquisition memo and its diligence checklist

An internal memo that turns the DealerEdge thesis into a plan for a possible
acquisition of Stocklist Dealer: the core model, testable assumptions, risks,
data needs, phased diligence with gates, and an operating model that keeps
the deal apart from the existing Stocklist delivery work. It lives under
strategy/, outside src/ and public/, so the site never builds it.
